name: Atvo Enterprises Limited
about: Atvo Enterprises Limited engages in the manufacture, export, and sale of various textile fabrics in India. The company offers socks, shirts, sweaters, readymade garments, and hosiery goods. It also engages in the commission and investment activities. The company was formerly known as Vandana Knitwear Limited and changed its name to Atvo Enterprises Limited in March 2025. Atvo Enterprises Limited was incorporated in 1995 and is based in Bhilwara, India.
